title: fix(service-automation)!: a flow script node runs its function by package (ADR-0150 D3)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBVU3HdyjhKXB8bjnu8sQmzj)_

Fixes #32073

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: follow-up #32264
Narrowing: a flow `script` node's function read and the published `AutomationEngine#resolveFunction` move from "the last registration" to a refusal for every name that means no single function for the calling flow (BREAKING items 2–7 below), and two packaged-flow shapes move to a different holder (items 8–9), each first-party count 0; the hook binder's own-package read is a widening (400 to served), and on an engine without `functionHoldersOf` it narrows (served to 400)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：flow 的 `script` 节点调用函数时，按「这条 flow 属于哪个包」来找函数（ADR-0150 D3）：先找自己包的，再找声明依赖里唯一的持有者，找不到唯一一个就拒绝并列出所有候选，不再随便取最后注册的那个。hook 按名字绑定自己包的函数时，也不再因为别的包注册了同名函数而被误拒。
- 为什么改：两个包注册同名函数时，alpha 包的 flow 实际跑的是 beta 包的代码（step 0 实测）；这是 #31527 epic 里函数这一类型还没按包解析的最后一个读取方。
- 风险与回滚：单持有者且在调用方可达范围内（自己包、依赖包、环境级、平台）答案不变；会变的是两持有者、依赖外唯一持有者（D3 (c)）、平台函数与包函数同名这几种情况，由「照跑某一个」变为步骤失败 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`。三个首方示例应用的计数都是 0。回滚即撤回此 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-automation/src/function-package-scope.ts`（新的解析桥）；`packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/screen-nodes.ts` 的 script 节点 catch 分支；`packages/objectql/src/hook-binder.ts` 的 `ownPackageFunction`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/flow-function-package-scope.test.ts`，预期 20/20 通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Flow `script` node (service-automation).** The node's function is resolved through the one package-scoped resolver for functions, `resolvePackageScopedFunction` (`@objectstack/objectql`, #31716), instead of the bare map's last registration.

- The caller is the package whose OWN body is armed under the flow's name, read through the engine's existing caller reader `flowCallerPackage(context)` → `armedFlowPackage` (the one `subflow`, `map` and `connector_action` names use). An environment-authored flow and an environment override of a packaged flow are callers with no package. Neither method is edited, so seat 1's PR-1a (slot-aware `flowCallerPackage`) reaches this node on merge with no change here.
- New module `function-package-scope.ts`: `packageScopedFunctionEngineOf(service)` (an `objectql` service with `functionHoldersOf` and a `registry`, else none), `functionResolverOf(engine)` (the engine's `FlowFunctionResolver`; a refused name THROWS `PackageScopedNameRefusedError`), and `isPackageScopedRefusal(e)` (by class, or by shape `code === 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT' && refusal.status === 'refused'`, the same predicate as runtime `domains/meta.ts`).
- `plugin.ts`'s `#1870` bridge now attaches `functionResolverOf(...)`. A host `objectql` without `functionHoldersOf` is left unbridged (fail closed).
- `AutomationEngine#resolveFunction(name, context?)` passes `this.flowCallerPackage(context)` to the resolver; `FlowFunctionResolver` gains `callerPackageId: string | null`.
- `builtin/screen-nodes.ts`: the script node catches the refusal and fails the step as a guard (`refuseNode`, as `connector_action`'s name refusal does), with the refusal's text, `code: 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT'` and `innerRefusal` (`refusalCarriedBy`). Every door that reports a failed run therefore answers `400 FLOW_FAILED` with `error.details.innerRefusal.code: 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT'`: `POST /automation/:name/trigger`, the resume door, a flow-type action at `/actions` (and MCP `run_action`), and a declared endpoint (all four build `flowFailureDetails`). In-flow, `$error.code` is `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`. Any other throw propagates as before.

**Hook binder (objectql, seat ruling Q2 = A).** `ownPackageFunction` reads `functionHoldersOf(name).packageItem(handlerOwnerPackageId(packageId))` and still requires the entry's owner to equal the bind's `packageId`. The own-package-only rule is unchanged.

**Docs.** `package-scoped-resolver.ts` (module header, `PackageScopedFunctionQuery`, `resolvePackageScopedFunction`) and `ObjectQL#functionHoldersOf` no longer say "no caller reads it yet" or "a flow or action"; they name the flow `script` node. `hook-binder.ts` no longer says an action `target` names a function, and its #30803 note now says the script node resolves in the calling flow's package (round 2, contract review N4).

**Not changed (seat ruling Q1 = A).** An action `target` never reaches the function registry: the script action arm dispatches `target` as a handler key in the action registry (`executeRegisteredAction`), which E2 #31737 already resolves by package. Measured on main `dee2e920` in step 0 (comment 6768303953 on #32073): all four action calls answered `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` and the function never ran. No function-bound action dispatch is opened here.

### BREAKING (declared `no (narrowing)`; first-party count 0 for each)

Measured on booted showcase, crm and multi-package at `dee2e920`: no function name has two holders, no owner-less function, and the one first-party `script` node (showcase `automation/flows/index.ts`) names its own package's `summarizeCompletedTask`.

1. A packaged flow naming a function two packages hold, one its own: FROM the last registration TO its own. A fix.
2. A flow with no package and a two-holder name: FROM the last registration TO the step failing `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (`ambiguous-in-environment`) naming both; the trigger door answers `400 FLOW_FAILED` carrying it.
3. ADR-0150 D3 (c): a packaged flow naming a function held only outside its declared closure: FROM served TO refused `outside-closure` naming the holder. The one answer a single holder moves.
4. The platform's owner-less function beside a package's: FROM the last registration TO refused naming both (a caller with no package, or a packaged flow holding none that reaches the package holder).
5. A packaged flow holding none, two holders in its closure: FROM the last registration TO refused `ambiguous-in-closure` naming both.
6. Published in-process API: `AutomationEngine#resolveFunction(name)` FROM the last registration TO `resolveFunction(name, context?)` throwing `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` for shapes 2–5. `FlowFunctionResolver` gains a second parameter; a one-parameter resolver still type-checks.
7. A host `objectql` service with `resolveFunction` but no `functionHoldersOf`: FROM bridged to the bare map TO unbridged ("no function named … is registered"). Every `ObjectQL` offers `functionHoldersOf`.
8. A packaged flow holding none, one holder in its closure and another outside it registered last: FROM the outside holder's function TO the closure holder's (served by a different holder, not refused).
9. A packaged flow holding none, the platform's function and a package holder outside its closure: FROM the last registration TO the platform's (served by a different holder, not refused).

**Widening (epic seat addition):** a hook whose string `handler` names its own package's engine-registered function (no `functions` handed to the bind) FROM refused `400 INVALID_REFERENCE` once another package registers the name TO bound to its own function. Every other holder is still refused `400 INVALID_REFERENCE`. Beside it: on an engine carrying `resolveFunctionEntry` but not `functionHoldersOf` (reachable only through a cast), a hook's own function goes FROM bound TO refused `400 INVALID_REFERENCE`, the class of item 7; and after `unregisterFunctionsByPackage` removes a name's last registrant, an earlier holder is served again where the bare map answered "no function" (no source caller).

The fix lines are in the changeset, one per moved answer.

## Tests

- `packages/services/service-automation/src/flow-function-package-scope.test.ts` (new, 20 cases, real `ObjectQL`, packages installed through `installPackage`, functions registered with owner `app:ID` as `AppPlugin` does):
  - two packages, one name, both registration orders: each packaged flow runs its own; own beats a closure holder;
  - refusals, each asserting the step text names every candidate, `innerRefusal.code === 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT'` and that no candidate ran: no-package two-holder, D3 (c) outside-closure, `ambiguous-in-closure`, platform beside a package holder (no caller, and via closure), a fault edge does not route past it;
  - `$error.code`: a `try_catch` catch region reads `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` off the failed script step (round 2, contract review S4);
  - the published read: `engine.resolveFunction(FN)` throws `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` with `code: 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT'`, `status: 409`, reason and both candidates;
  - CONTROLs, one holder: own (with its declared `effect`), closure, environment-wide, platform; an unregistered name still fails "no function named" with no `innerRefusal`;
  - an environment override of P's flow resolves with no caller (reaches a holder outside P's closure; two holders including P refused);
  - the automation plugin attaches the resolver at boot (`LiteKernel`), and a service without `functionHoldersOf` is left unbridged.
- `packages/objectql/src/hook-binder-package-scope.test.ts`: new describe, two packages each register `shared_stamp`: A's later hook binds A's (the widening), B's binds B's, a non-holder and the platform's function are refused with `HOOK_HANDLER_NOT_IN_PACKAGE_CODE` / `_STATUS`. The existing "own package registered in an earlier bind" case is the one-holder CONTROL.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/bare-name-one-holder-request-family.dogfood.test.ts` (booted showcase plus `com.qa.bare.alpha` and `com.qa.bare.beta`, which already ship the function `qa_shared_fn`): each package ships two script flows; four cases: each package's flow runs its own function; a `PUT /meta/flow` flow with no package is `400 FLOW_FAILED` with `innerRefusal.code: 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT'` naming both; beta's flow naming alpha's one-holder function is refused outside-closure; CONTROL: alpha's one-holder function runs for alpha's flow and for a flow with no package.

<details><summary>Ablation (one-time; no ablation file kept)</summary>

Fix committed first; `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, then `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs`.

- Leg 1, the bridge: `functionResolverOf`'s `resolvePackageScopedFunction(...)` replaced by the bare map's `resolveFunctionEntry(name)` (main's answer). service-automation rebuilt; marker `resolveFunctionEntry(name)` proved in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.cjs`. Red: unit 11 of 19 (every two-holder, refusal, override-refusal and plugin case; e.g. A's flow ran `com.acme.stranger`), dogfood 3 of 12 (alpha's flow ran beta's; the no-package and D3 (c) flows succeeded). The 8 unit CONTROLs and the dogfood CONTROL stayed green.
- Leg 2, the hook binder: `ownPackageFunction`'s holders read replaced by `resolveFunctionEntry(name)`. Red: 1 of 12, the widening case (`INVALID_REFERENCE` on A's own function). The refusals and the one-holder CONTROL stayed green.
- Restore: `git checkout HEAD --` both files, `git status --porcelain` empty, service-automation rebuilt, `--absent` preflight clean (6 built files), unit 19/19, hook 12/12, dogfood file 12/12.
- Round 2, leg 3, the node's `code` (S4): `code: 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT',` removed from the script node's refusal arm (unit tests read `src`). Red: 1 of 20, the `$error.code` case ("expected undefined to be 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT'"). Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, tree clean, 20/20.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Serial: seat 1's PR-1a #32239 (which superseded #32091) merged as `c62e72a4`; this branch merged `origin/main` at `3191e007` (a merge commit, no conflict), then again at `84208647` once child B #32213 had landed (a merge commit). That second merge had one conflict, in the header comment of `bare-name-one-holder-request-family.dogfood.test.ts`. Kept from #32213: its header paragraph (child B narrows the object-less action to the namespace), the namespaced `inline()` manifest, `messageOf`, `expectMetaRefused`, `metaAt`, its rewritten cold-boot warning and install-local cases, and every case it added. Kept from this PR: its header paragraph, `ALPHA_FN`, `fnRuns`/`takeRuns`, `fnFlow`, the two script flows and the recording functions in `bootPackage`, `trigger`, and its four cases. Measured against `origin/main`, the merged file removes one line, `functions: { [FN]: async () => p }`, which this PR replaces with the recording functions; it removes none of #32213's assertions. In the merged tree `resolveFunction` calls #32239's slot-aware `flowCallerPackage(context)` (`flowKeyOfRun`, then `armedFlowPackage`) unchanged, and the script node, the bridge and `setFunctionResolver` are still the only in-tree readers.
- Text left as is, outside this card: phase 1's refusal sentence (`bare-name-one-holder.ts:462`, and the module header near line 43) still says an action `target` names a function; rewording it belongs with the backstop child that narrows phase 1's refusal (ADR-0150 D9). The stale sentences in files this PR edits (`hook-binder.ts` near 200 and 207, objectql `engine.ts` `functionHoldersOf`, `package-scoped-resolver.ts`) are fixed in round 2 (contract review N4).
- The hook-binder fix keeps own-package-only. Serving a closure holder there would reverse the rule `hook-binder-package-scope.test.ts` pins, so it is not done here.
- Footer: the PR body ends with os-dev.md's session-URL footer form instead of the harness's two-line form.
